thread:
nina: Quick sync 1: thinking about auto-rollback thresholds for the new routing heuristics. want a consensus on signals.
ajay: +1. keep initial exposure low (5-10%) and limit to non-critical tenants.
matt: 5% max. measure p99 and p99.9 tails, not just p95. small samples will lie.
ivy: for infra issues (5xx, gpu OOM, p99 spike) I want an immediate cut if >30% regressed for 5m.
sam: how do we baseline for brand-new variants?
nina: use the stable variant as rolling baseline, 15m warmup; fallback to global baseline if sparse.
ajay: separate infra vs quality signals. infra -> immediate cut. quality (LLR/quality_score) -> staged rampdown + human review.
matt: agree. also require min_samples for quality triggers (suggest 200).
ivy: propose knobs: max_pct=5, infra_pct=30, infra_window_s=300, quality_pct=10, quality_window_s=900, min_samples=200.
sam: add "consecutive_windows": 2 to avoid flapping.
deploy-bot: simulate --variant=dark-v2 --baseline=stable --window=900 --min-samples=200
deploy-bot: simulation: false-positive rollback ~2.5% @5% traffic, 1.0% @2% traffic.
ajay: looks reasonable. add cooldown: lock variant for 30m after rollback and cap subsequent launches to 2% for that route.
matt: router should defer decisioning to a tiny policy service that subscribes aggregated metrics and issues signed decisions.
ivy: security: signed decision tokens + immutable decision id + rate-limit decision updates per route.
sam: for quality drops, try mitigations first (rerank, cache, shorten prompt) and monitor mitigation effectiveness before cutting.
nina: good. ensure mitigation telemetry (effectiveness, applied_count) is emitted.
ajay: UI/DSl for console: short example shown as JSON policy block. will draft in RFC.
ivy: I'll assemble a short RFC fragment with knobs + sim outputs and tag reviewers.
matt: add runbook note: auto-rollback creates P2 alert, attach last 1m traces and evaluation prompts.
nina: thanks 1, please include simulation logs from deploy-bot in the RFC.
deploy-bot: artifacts uploaded to /rfc/arch/dark-launch/sim-1758024681
